akr3m: Emil "Saint" Akr arrived on Day 12 as a replacement. The men in N-F3 had been fighting for 12 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world. The new duty roster listed Emil "Saint" Akr as a sniper. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

Edmund Szymanski of the Hegemony lobbed a tin of jam over the wire at the Chalk Pits. It came back empty, washed, with a flower inside and Emil "Saint" Akr's name scratched on the lid. A letter from home found Emil "Saint" Akr before the night shift. Emil "Saint" Akr folded it small and kept it close.

Wiring party. Emil "Saint" Akr held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at N-F3, and everyone came back. A letter from home found Emil "Saint" Akr before the night shift. Emil "Saint" Akr folded it small and kept it close.

Hugo "Parson" Wpjarrell taught Emil "Saint" Akr to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop. A letter from home found Emil "Saint" Akr before the night shift. Emil "Saint" Akr folded it small and kept it close.
On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Emil "Saint" Akr was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire.
Emil "Saint" Akr returned to N-F3 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
Emil carried Severin Priv's pack for half a mile and never said a word. Severin Priv noticed.
axel.crdw: On Day 9 Florian Crdw took a post at R-C2 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He hums hymns when frightened, and the men liked him for it.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-C2 with the rations. Florian Crdw ate while listening to the revised orders.

At Grey Mill, Marek "Button" Gergely and Florian Crdw exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent. Florian Crdw got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 779. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Florian Crdw kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Florian Crdw gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
Florian Crdw did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Florian Crdw fired back. Felix Yummygraingo was grazed.
Florian Crdw tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
A shell knocked in the parapet at R-C2. Florian Crdw was dug out of the sandbags bruised, coughing, and furious.
Florian Crdw is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
Florian Crdw's hands still remember being a farmhand's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.

Florian was reaching for a canteen at R-C2 when a round tore the strap in two. It also tore a line across his hand. Shot by Ivo "Ash" Solyommadar of the Hegemony (@solyommadar11). Florian fired a single round through a crack in the enemy's steel plate, a gap no wider than a finger. Wendel "Spark" Floooring was badly wounded.
bmiller_08: Matthias Bmiller told the sergeant he was a choir singer. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.

Machine-gun fire swept Q-F6. Matthias Bmiller took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Karel Mstk of the Concord (@sam_mstk13). Mail came up the line with a letter for Matthias Bmiller. Matthias Bmiller read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Matthias Bmiller walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

A medic brought Matthias Bmiller half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real. Mail came up the line with a letter for Matthias Bmiller. Matthias Bmiller read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

For days Matthias Bmiller was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle. Mail came up the line with a letter for Matthias Bmiller. Matthias Bmiller read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The sergeant at Q-F6 called out a range and a spot. Matthias Bmiller was the only one who hit it. Casimir Toz was grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Matthias Bmiller. Matthias Bmiller read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Matthias Bmiller tried to remember the price of a loaf in Halden. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought. Mail came up the line with a letter for Matthias Bmiller. Matthias Bmiller read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
New laces made Matthias Bmiller's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.

A bullet found Matthias Bmiller at Q-F6, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Matthias "Owl" Femgoobert of the Concord (@femgoobert). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Matthias Bmiller fell at Q-F6 and never moved again. Shot by Matthias "Owl" Femgoobert of the Concord (@femgoobert).
A letter came with Ivo Bmiller: "I am Matthias Bmiller's brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

Ivo had Cyril "Ghost" Jacobmohorci of the Concord in the sights at the Sunken Road for a long second. Cyril "Ghost" Jacobmohorci was lighting a pipe. Ivo let the match burn all the way down. The letter for Ivo had been in the rain somewhere along the way. Ivo dried it by the stove, page by page.
chuckemuckle: Otto Chuckemuckle stepped off the supply cart at P-F18 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Otto Chuckemuckle did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Nils King and Otto Chuckemuckle argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war. A letter from home reached Otto Chuckemuckle before dusk. Otto Chuckemuckle read it twice and slept a little easier.
Otto Chuckemuckle fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Tobias Sckweet was badly wounded. Otto Chuckemuckle ate breakfast without a word.
Otto Chuckemuckle had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Dorian Hexofdex crossed it, Otto Chuckemuckle fired. Dorian Hexofdex was badly wounded.

Otto Chuckemuckle fired at the enemy dawn watch from P-F18. Zeno Meow was badly wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. A letter from home reached Otto Chuckemuckle before dusk. Otto Chuckemuckle read it twice and slept a little easier.
Otto Chuckemuckle was on watch at P-F18 when the night raid hit. The men found Otto Chuckemuckle at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Henrik Darryl of the Concord (@whoa_darryl).
The papers connected Isidor Chuckemuckle to Otto Chuckemuckle. The men took longer to learn Isidor Chuckemuckle's own habits, but they made the effort.
Isidor Chuckemuckle's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
A second spoon disappeared. Isidor searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry.
daltonellis45: On Day 15 Tobias Daltonellis took a post at N-F20 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He whistles the same four notes over and over, and the men liked him for it.
Tobias Daltonellis laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago.

Tobias Daltonellis caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again. Now serving as a rifleman, Tobias discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Tobias as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
generic_templar1862: Day 9. The corporal put Severin Templar beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into S-C1. Severin Templar has learned to walk bent double.

There is a sniper across the way the men call Grey Hat. Three helmets went up on sticks today. Grey Hat hit all three. Severin Templar watched where the shots came from. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Severin Templar answered to number 762. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Severin Templar watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Severin Templar lay in the ruins of the Chalk Pits all day. Grey Hat did not fire once. Neither did Severin Templar. Both of them know.
Severin Templar measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
Zeno "Brick" Peter held the mirror while Severin Templar shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
At dusk a glint from the ridge. Severin Templar fired once. The front has been quiet ever since, and nobody talks about Grey Hat any more.
Shell splinters peppered S-C1. Severin Templar picked three out of his sleeve and a fourth out of his arm.
The medic cut the last bandage off Severin Templar's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to S-C1 the same hour.
Severin noticed regular flashes from a crack in an old stone wall. The position looks obvious enough to make him suspicious.
henrywestgaming1812: Teodor "Smokes" Henrywestgam arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-R3 with the rations. Teodor "Smokes" Henrywestgam ate while listening to the revised orders.

A round went through Teodor "Smokes" Henrywestgam's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Lucien Zag of the Hegemony (@grz_zag420). The clerk counted the names twice. Teodor "Smokes" Henrywestgam is number 981 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Teodor "Smokes" Henrywestgam watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
The medic looked at Teodor "Smokes" Henrywestgam's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to S-R3. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Teodor "Smokes" Henrywestgam fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Severin Ech, grazed.
Teodor "Smokes" Henrywestgam lent Ulrich Yeti a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.
Teodor "Smokes" Henrywestgam saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at S-R3 and fired once. Albin Prokes was badly wounded.
Teodor "Smokes" Henrywestgam taught Gustav Joodiizzzlee to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.
Teodor "Smokes" Henrywestgam tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
Teodor traded half a ration of tobacco for a better rifle oil. The deal was fair, and nobody else would have made it.
jetsonxwright: Gideon Jetsonxwrigh reported to N-F5 with a bullet that missed him sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.

Gideon Jetsonxwrigh reached up to fix a sandbag at N-F5 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Hugo "Parson" Wpjarrell of the Concord (@wpjarrell07). A thin letter reached Gideon Jetsonxwrigh. Only five lines long, and Gideon Jetsonxwrigh knew every one of them by heart before supper.

The medic looked at Gideon Jetsonxwrigh's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to N-F5. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. Gideon Jetsonxwrigh read the letter out loud to the squad, skipping the private parts. The men asked to hear it again.
Gideon wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
logan.rudolph07: Wendel Rudolph unpacked a cracked shaving mirror at M-F7. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
Wendel checked the wire at M-F7 on his hands and knees. It was whole. He returned before dawn with mud on his chin.
matija_toma: Tobias "Owl" Toma left a younger sister who sends drawings behind in Ashford Vale and came up the line with a stub of a pencil. The men noticed at once that he shares cigarettes but never smokes.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Tobias "Owl" Toma has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.

Tobias "Owl" Toma fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Oskar Perry, now badly wounded. The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Tobias "Owl" Toma looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Tobias "Owl" Toma asked to see the second one. The barber laughed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Tobias "Owl" Toma is number 592. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Tobias "Owl" Toma wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Tobias "Owl" Toma wrote a song about Lantern Hill. Cyril "Spark" Jesus wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
The parcel for Tobias "Owl" Toma contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
Tobias "Owl" Toma drew the counter-mine plans by candlelight. Below Sorrow Copse the earth is now a maze, and he knows every turn.
Tobias "Owl" Toma sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Tobias "Owl" Toma pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
Tobias "Owl" Toma lost a boot in the trench. Jakub Superiority found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word.
Rumour reached S-S1 that the war would be over by spring. Tobias has heard it before. So has everyone.
nicholas_carlson: Valentin Carlson introduced himself as a farmhand from Dunmarrow. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
A crow sat on the parapet above Valentin Carlson all afternoon. The men say it chose him.
Two carrying parties met in the narrow trench. Valentin Carlson helped work out how an ammunition box and a very large kettle could pass each other.
Valentin Carlson lost a boot in the trench. Wendel Goober found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word.

Valentin Carlson jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Roland "Ash" Hud. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@hay_ant_hud) Valentin Carlson went over with the raiders and dropped into the Hegemony trench. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@zaboravljeninemanjic) A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at R-S7. Valentin Carlson was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso of the Hegemony (@jozifanderson).
Lucien Carlson joined R-S7 under the shadow of Valentin Carlson's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

A stretcher party needed the passage. Lucien Carlson backed into a recess with an ammunition box and stayed there until the last bearer passed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Lucien Carlson is number 444. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Lucien Carlson watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Lucien Carlson fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Cyril "Hollow" Mcplate was grazed.
Lucien Carlson spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet hit Lucien Carlson in the neck at R-S7. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. A man in the hospital dugout died before dawn, and his bed went to Lucien Carlson. Nobody pretends that is not how it works. Lucien Carlson's fever broke in the night. The orderly checked the chart twice and smiled for the first time in a week. Mail came up the line with a letter for Lucien Carlson. Lucien Carlson read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Lucien Carlson spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
Lucien Carlson did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
The papers say Otto Carlson. The sergeant says he has his older brother's eyes. Lucien Carlson's eyes. Nobody in R-S7 argues.
A familiar voice came out of the fog in the wrong direction. Otto Carlson waited for the password before answering.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Otto put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
noraajs: Nils Noraajs arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying his mother's thimble and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Shrapnel tore through Nils Noraajs at R-C2. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. The bleeding has stopped. Nils Noraajs asked for a pencil and paper, and the orderlies took it as the best sign they had seen. Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Nils Noraajs shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Nils Noraajs spent the day in bed with his leg propped up. The orderly changed the dressing and said it was healing the way it should. Nils Noraajs got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 831. The men who came later will ask about it. Victory at Grey Mill. Nils Noraajs let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Nils Noraajs returned to R-C2 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
Cyril "Bones" Garbo of the Concord shouted across the wire at the Drowned Farm, asking for the football scores from home. Nils Noraajs of the Hegemony shouted them back. Some of them were even true.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Nils Noraajs asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
Nils Noraajs was sent to examine a pump that worked only when struck. He asked the men to stop striking it long enough to listen.
Cyril Greedndreadn (Concord) and Nils Noraajs (Hegemony) watched each other through the same loophole at the Bone Quarry for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why.
A splinter of duckboard, kicked up by a shell, went into Nils Noraajs's calf. The medic pulled it out with pliers. Nils Noraajs did not make a sound.
The bandage came off Nils's head today. His helmet no longer fits properly. He wears it anyway.
ooze_incorporated: Silas Incorporated came from Millbank, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Silas found a packet of seeds in a ruined house and put them in a tin of soil on the parapet at N-F23.
rals.ham: Nobody saw Marek Ham arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in R-F14, and a quiet machine gunner under it.
Marek Ham is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
Marek Ham washed his face and was asked whether headquarters was visiting. Apparently cleanliness requires an explanation.

On a quiet night Marek Ham (Concord) and Edmund Matteozrybak (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there. Marek Ham walked the captured trenches of Verdel Ridge and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Shell splinters peppered R-F14. Marek Ham picked three out of his sleeve and a fourth out of his arm.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Marek Ham is whole again, or near enough for the line. A letter from home found Marek Ham before the night shift. Marek Ham folded it small and kept it close.

Marek Ham lost a boot to the mud at R-F14. It took two men and a rifle sling to get it back. The mud kept the sock. The Hegemony won Hill 304. In R-F14, Marek Ham listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A shell landed close to R-F14. When the dust settled Marek Ham was still there, holding a letter he never sent, laughing without sound. A letter from home found Marek Ham before the night shift. Marek Ham folded it small and kept it close.

Marek Ham borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. A letter from home found Marek Ham before the night shift. Marek Ham folded it small and kept it close.
Marek Ham saw shapes coming through the gap in the wire and fired along it. The shapes went to ground. One of them was Teodor Acakostic, grazed.

The men at R-F14 heard Marek Ham call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Konrad Jngaf of the Hegemony (@gremlin_jngaf). Marek Ham was killed at R-F14 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Konrad Jngaf of the Hegemony (@gremlin_jngaf).

Dorian "Crow" Ham put a letter he never sent beside the bunk. Someone who had known Marek Ham helped clear the shelf without saying why. The First Wave ribbon marked Dorian "Crow" Ham as an early volunteer. At R-F14, a newcomer asked what those first days had been like.

A sniper's bullet hit Dorian "Crow" Ham at R-F14. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Marek Elox of the Hegemony (@gm_elox). Dorian "Crow" Ham was killed on watch at R-F14. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Marek Elox of the Hegemony (@gm_elox).

The papers connected Gideon "Brick" Ham to Dorian "Crow" Ham. The men took longer to learn Gideon "Brick" Ham's own habits, but they made the effort. Volunteer number 83. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Gideon "Brick" Ham's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.' After what happened at the Bone Quarry, Gideon "Brick" Ham asked to serve as a sapper. Nobody argued.

Gideon "Brick" Ham was hit in the hip at R-F14. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Oskar "Rabbit" Nathan of the Hegemony (@nathan156910). Gideon "Brick" Ham stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-F14. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Oskar "Rabbit" Nathan of the Hegemony (@nathan156910).

Norbert "Mole" Ham asked about Gideon "Brick" Ham on arriving at R-F14. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. Norbert "Mole" Ham's First Wave ribbon drew a question at supper. He remembered the queue at the depot more clearly than the speech. After the loss of Grey Mill, Norbert "Mole" Ham helped stack spare sandbags at R-F14. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Norbert "Mole" Ham spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.

Norbert "Mole" Ham checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone. A letter from home found Norbert "Mole" Ham before the night shift. Norbert "Mole" Ham folded it small and kept it close.
Norbert "Mole" Ham polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.

Norbert "Mole" Ham went out with a patrol to Calvary Farm and did not come back with it. He is listed as missing. The men leave his rations untouched. A letter from home found Norbert "Mole" Ham before the night shift. Norbert "Mole" Ham folded it small and kept it close.

The missing report was still on the desk when Norbert "Mole" Ham walked in. The clerk crossed it out hard enough to tear the paper. The letter for Norbert "Mole" Ham had a few coins taped inside. They would buy almost nothing here, but Norbert "Mole" Ham kept them.

Norbert "Mole" Ham checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more. A thin letter reached Norbert "Mole" Ham. Only five lines long, and Norbert "Mole" Ham knew every one of them by heart before supper. The transfer made Norbert "Mole" Ham a machine gunner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

A bullet went through Norbert's upper arm at R-F14 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Florian "Parson" Nonly of the Hegemony (@leopoldda1nonly). Norbert was killed outright at R-F14, a single bullet from across the wire.
Leopold Ham joined R-F14 under the shadow of Norbert "Mole" Ham's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
strawberrrryfield_: Otto Strawberrrry arrived on Day 12 as a replacement. The men in V-F12 had been fighting for 12 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
Otto Strawberrrry was asked to arrange a gathering for men who did not want a sermon. He asked what they did want and wrote down the answers.
The list for Otto Strawberrrry's gathering contains a poem, a song and a request for five minutes without orders. All three seem possible.
Otto Strawberrrry mended the hole in Zeno Loganhawkins's trousers with fishing line and a bent pin. Zeno says the patch is stronger than the trousers.

The Concord raiders came over at V-F12 in the middle of the night. Otto Strawberrrry met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Matthias Yoboiwhitech of the Concord (@yoboiwhitecheddar).
The House of Strawberrrry sent Walter "Hollow" Strawberrrry after Otto Strawberrrry. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
At Sorrow Copse, Oskar Ohl and Walter "Hollow" Strawberrrry exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent.
Walter and Ulrich "Bones" Cocac spotted each other across a ruined orchard at the Chalk Pits. Both raised a hand. Both lowered it quickly.
toastybweady: Felix "Spark" Toastybweady reported to S-F18 with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Felix "Spark" Toastybweady asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Felix "Spark" Toastybweady. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.

A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Felix "Spark" Toastybweady gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page. After the loss of Hill 304, Felix "Spark" Toastybweady helped stack spare sandbags at S-F18. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
The last of the jam was shared by scraping it onto a biscuit. Felix "Spark" Toastybweady approved the method.
Felix "Spark" Toastybweady had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Emil Ghostbebrii crossed it, Felix "Spark" Toastybweady fired. Emil Ghostbebrii was badly wounded.
In the fog a figure walked along the parapet of S-F18. When Felix "Spark" Toastybweady challenged it, there was nobody there.

Felix "Spark" Toastybweady fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at S-F18. Before dawn Zeno Ramsey walked into it, grazed. Felix "Spark" Toastybweady rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Walter Small was grazed at the far edge of no man's land.

Felix "Spark" Toastybweady was on watch at S-F18 when the night raid hit. The men found Felix "Spark" Toastybweady at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Walter Juizy of the Hegemony (@juizy_44).
Nils "Rabbit" Toastybweady joined S-F18 under the shadow of Felix "Spark" Toastybweady's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Nils "Rabbit" Toastybweady agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age. Nils "Rabbit" Toastybweady got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 211. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Nils "Rabbit" Toastybweady stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Nils "Rabbit" Toastybweady was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.
Nils "Rabbit" Toastybweady traded a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.
At S-F18 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Nils "Rabbit" Toastybweady won the bet. Zeno Ramsey was grazed.
Nils "Rabbit" Toastybweady fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Walter Small was badly wounded, and that rifle did not fire again tonight.

Nils "Rabbit" Toastybweady was on the dawn watch at S-F18 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Nils "Rabbit" Toastybweady was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein of the Hegemony (@wyatthohbein).
The medic told Nils "Rabbit" Toastybweady to keep the bandage clean. Nils "Rabbit" Toastybweady has been guarding it like a medal.
A medic told Nils to rest one more day. Nils smiled, thanked the medic, and was at S-F18 before lunch.
xaviet_man: Cyril "Owl" Man joined the replacements on Day 15. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
A bullet hit Cyril "Owl" Man's belt buckle at V-F20 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Cyril Monsterjohn of the Concord (@monsterjohn).
The medic cut the last bandage off Cyril "Owl" Man's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to V-F20 the same hour.
Cyril was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.
yanis_ey522: They issued Norbert "Mole" Yanis a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a letter he never sent in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Norbert "Mole" Yanis wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Norbert "Mole" Yanis fired, and Bastian Ebrrrvole was badly wounded. Norbert "Mole" Yanis got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 883. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Norbert "Mole" Yanis kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Norbert "Mole" Yanis found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Norbert "Mole" Yanis changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
The cook borrowed Norbert "Mole" Yanis's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
Norbert "Mole" Yanis's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
Norbert "Mole" Yanis fired at a movement across the wire at R-R13. The man went down: Pavel Reider, badly wounded.
Norbert "Mole" Yanis had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Lucien Warwacko was gravely wounded.
Face blackened with soot, Norbert spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Jonas Ethanlam was gravely wounded.
